name: Danis Piron Lara
crime: Pleaded guilty: BOSTON – A Dominican man unlawfully residing in Dorchester pleaded guilty in federal court in Boston to Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits fraud and false writing relating health care matters. Danis Piron Lara, 51, pleaded guilty to unlawfully obtaining SNAP Benefits and making a false writing relating to health care matters.

name: Argenis Alfredo Brizo-Mendoza
crime: Convicted: Argenis Alfredo Brizo-Mendoza, 31, pleaded guilty to conspiracy to distribute and possess with intent to distribute fentanyl and was sentenced to 134 months in federal prison by U.S. District Judge Sean D. Jordan on October 30, 2026. According to information presented in court, Brizo-Mendoza, a citizen of Honduras, was a drug courier for a drug trafficking organization that supplied various narcotics, mostly fentanyl and methamphetamine from Mexico.

name: Liang Xiong
crime: Pleaded guilty: ST. LOUIS – A Chinese national pleaded guilty Wednesday and admitted participating in a nationwide scam involving gift cards. Liang Xiong, 39, pleaded guilty in U.S. District Court in St. Louis to one count of possession of 15 or more unauthorized access devices. Court documents indicate Xiong entered the country illegally through Mexico and has a pending asylum claim.
